title: China's Largest Lake Sits 3,200m Up | Qinghai-Gansu Loop EP2 | China Travel Expert
description:
China's biggest lake sits about 3,200 meters up on the plateau — and it's salt water, not fresh.

Qinghai Lake covers more than 4,600 square kilometers with a shoreline around 360 km, making it China's largest inland saltwater lake and the highest-altitude lake among the world's 50 largest. It's roughly 150 km from Xining. Its Bird Islands on the western side have been a protected sanctuary since 1997. This is stop two on my Qinghai–Gansu loop — a route you can cycle stretches of, chasing the afternoon light around the water.

🧭 Expert Tip: Stay a night right by the lake instead of doing it as a day trip from Xining. The dawn light over the water is the reason to come — and the reward stop is a bowl of warm yak yogurt from a lakeside stall.

中国最大的湖，海拔3200米、还是咸水——这就是青海湖，青甘大环线第二站。
